title: Research in Inequality
description: This is a research course on content analysis of American culture. We investigate and try to quantify changes in American culture that might help us understand changes in different types of inequality. Our use of content analyses will look for patterns in several cultural sources (e.g., books, newspapers, films, other?) that might show evidence of cultural changes relevant to inequality. The exercises, readings, and short papers are all designed to involve students in ongoing research questions that remain unresolved.
